items.criterion: FuXi extends the skillful forecast lead time (defined as ACC >= 0.6) for Z500 from 9.25 days (ECMWF HRES) to 10.5 days, and for T2M from 10 days to 14.5 days. In 15-day forecasts, FuXi achieves higher ACC than ECMWF ensemble mean on 67.92% and lower RMSE on 53.75% of all 240 variable-level-lead time combinations, demonstrating that the cascade ML approach achieves performance comparable to the world's leading operational ensemble prediction system.

FuXi outperforms ECMWF EM in 0-9 day forecasts and achieves comparable performance overall, with higher ACC on 67.92% and lower RMSE on 53.75% of all 240 variable-level-lead time combinations.

items.criterion: Figure 3: Spatial distribution of Z500 geopotential height forecasts at different lead times (1, 3, 5, 7, 10 days) comparing ERA5 reanalysis (ground truth), ECMWF HRES, and FuXi predictions. FuXi maintains sharper and more accurate synoptic-scale weather patterns compared to ECMWF HRES at extended lead times. At 10-day lead time, FuXi still captures the major trough-ridge patterns while HRES shows more smoothing and spatial degradation. This demonstrates FuXi's superior ability to preserve fine-scale atmospheric structures in medium-range forecasts.
